item.title: Katy Perry, Future, LISA, J Balvin, Alanis Morissette & Tyla to Perform at 2026 FIFA World Cup Opening Ceremonies: Report
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we're talking about the biggest events in music and sports. And what's bigger than the FIFA World Cup? The 2026 FIFA World Cup is just around the corner, and we've got the scoop on the star-studded lineup for the opening ceremonies."
[Music transitions to a lively tune]
Host: "Katy Perry is headlining the opening ceremony in Los Angeles, where the US men's national team will take on Paraguay on June 12. She'll be joined by Future and DJ Sanjoy at the SoFi Stadium. But that's not all - Michael Bublé, Alessia Cara, and Alanis Morissette will be performing in Toronto, where Canada will face off against Bosnia & Herzegovina."
[Music transitions to a Latin-inspired beat]
Host: "And in Mexico, rock band Maná, Tyla, and Los Ángeles Azules will get the crowd going at the Azteca Stadium on June 11. We're also expecting performances from J Balvin, Danny Ocean, Elyanna, Marilina Bogado, and many more talented artists around the globe."
[Music transitions back to the intro tune]
Host: "And if that's not enough, an official FIFA World Cup album is on the way, featuring a reggaetón-Afrobeats fusion track from Shakira and Burna Boy, called 'Dai Dai'. We can't wait to see what the rest of the World Cup has in store for us. Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for listening!"
[Outro music plays]
